# Libraries

```{r libraries}
# importing libraries
library(augsynth)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
```

# Analysis and file settings

```{r settings}
# Analysis and file settings
death_col <- "female_firearm_homicides"
pop_col <- "female_population"
outcome_label <- "Female firearm homicide rate"
output_prefix <- "female"

treated_state <- "New Jersey"
treatment_year <- 2019

input_file <- "~/Downloads/firearm_deaths_population_new.csv"
output_dir <- "~/Downloads"


# Set the legend position.
legend_position_choice <- "upper_left"

# Set the dimensions and resolution of the saved plots.
plot_width <- 10
plot_height <- 6
plot_dpi <- 300

# Set the font sizes used in the plots.
base_font_size <- 14
title_font_size <- 16
axis_title_font_size <- 14
axis_text_font_size <- 11
legend_font_size <- 12

# Define a function that converts the selected legend location into plot coordinates.
get_legend_position <- function(choice) {
  if (choice == "upper_left") return(c(0.25, 0.8))
  if (choice == "upper_right") return(c(0.82, 0.88))
  if (choice == "lower_left") return(c(0.18, 0.18))
  if (choice == "lower_right") return(c(0.82, 0.18))
  if (choice == "bottom") return("bottom")
  if (choice == "none") return("none")
  return(c(0.25, 0.8))
}

# Define a function that identifies the subgroup from the outcome label.
get_subgroup_label <- function(outcome_label) {
  x <- tolower(outcome_label)
  if (grepl("female", x)) return("Female")
  if (grepl("male", x)) return("Male")
  return("Overall")
}

# Create the subgroup label and plot title.
plot_subgroup <- get_subgroup_label(outcome_label)
plot_title <- paste0(treated_state, ", ", plot_subgroup)

# Define a function that saves a printed model summary as a CSV file.
save_summary_csv <- function(summary_obj, file_name) {
  write_csv(
    data.frame(line = capture.output(print(summary_obj))),
    file.path(output_dir, file_name)
  )
}
```

# Data preparation

```{r data_preparation}
# Extract the donor weights from the fitted ASCM model
df_raw <- read_csv(input_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Prepare state-level firearm homicide rate data.
df_state <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    state = trimws(as.character(state)),
    year = as.numeric(year),
    death_count = as.numeric(.data[[death_col]]),
    pop_count = as.numeric(.data[[pop_col]])
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 1999, year <= 2023) %>%
  filter(state == treated_state | state %in% non_erpo_states) %>%
  group_by(state, year) %>%
  summarise(
    death_count = sum(death_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    pop_count = sum(pop_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_rate = (death_count / pop_count) * 100000,
    treated = ifelse(state == treated_state, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(outcome_rate), is.finite(outcome_rate))

# Identify states with data available from 1999 through 2023.
complete_states <- df_state %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(n_years = n_distinct(year), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_years == length(1999:2023)) %>%
  pull(state)

# Keep states with complete data.
df_state <- df_state %>%
  filter(state %in% complete_states) %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

# ASCM analysis and statistical inference

```{r ascm_inference}
# Fit the augmented synthetic control model.
fit_ascm <- augsynth(
  outcome_rate ~ treated,
  unit = state,
  time = year,
  t_int = treatment_year,
  data = df_state,
  progfunc = "Ridge",
  scm = TRUE
)

# Generate the ASCM, permutation, and jackknife+ results.
s_ascm <- summary(fit_ascm)
s_perm <- summary(fit_ascm, inf_type = "permutation")
s_jackknife <- summary(fit_ascm, inf_type = "jackknife+", alpha = 0.05)

# Print the results.
print(s_ascm)
print(s_perm)
print(s_jackknife)

# Save the results as CSV files.
save_summary_csv(s_ascm, paste0(output_prefix, "_ascm_summary.csv"))
save_summary_csv(s_perm, paste0(output_prefix, "_permutation_summary.csv"))
save_summary_csv(s_jackknife, paste0(output_prefix, "_jackknife_plus_summary.csv")
)
```

# Observed and synthetic outcomes

```{r observed_synthetic}
# Extract the donor weights from the fitted ASCM model.
w <- weights(fit_ascm)

# Organize the donor-state weights in a data frame.
w_df <- data.frame(
  state = rownames(w),
  weight = as.numeric(w[, 1]),
  row.names = NULL
)

# Identify the three donor states with the largest absolute weights.
top_loo_states <- w_df %>%
  filter(state != treated_state) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(weight))) %>%
  slice(1:3) %>%
  pull(state)

# Define a function to calculate the synthetic outcome series from donor weights.
get_synthetic_series <- function(fit_obj, data_obj, treated_state_name) {
  temp_w <- weights(fit_obj)
  
  temp_w_df <- data.frame(
    state = rownames(temp_w),
    weight = as.numeric(temp_w[, 1]),
    row.names = NULL
  )
  
  data_obj %>%
    filter(state != treated_state_name) %>%
    left_join(temp_w_df, by = "state") %>%
    filter(!is.na(weight)) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      synthetic = sum(weight * outcome_rate),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# Calculate the synthetic outcome series for New Jersey.
synthetic_df <- get_synthetic_series(
  fit_obj = fit_ascm,
  data_obj = df_state,
  treated_state_name = treated_state
)

# Extract the observed outcome series for New Jersey.
observed_df <- df_state %>%
  filter(state == treated_state) %>%
  select(year, observed = outcome_rate)

# Combine the observed and synthetic series for plotting.
plot_df <- observed_df %>%
  left_join(synthetic_df, by = "year") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(observed, synthetic),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "rate"
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = ifelse(type == "observed", "Observed", "Synthetic"))

# Calculate the yearly differences between the observed and synthetic rates.
gap_df <- observed_df %>%
  left_join(synthetic_df, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(gap = observed - synthetic)

# Calculate the average treatment effect during the postintervention period.
main_att <- gap_df %>%
  filter(year >= treatment_year) %>%
  summarise(avg_att = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(avg_att)

# Define a consistent theme for all plots.
common_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = base_font_size) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = title_font_size, hjust = 0),
    axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_font_size),
    axis.text = element_text(size = axis_text_font_size),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = legend_font_size),
    legend.position = get_legend_position(legend_position_choice),
    legend.background = element_rect(color = "gray70", fill = "white", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray85", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4)
  )

# Plot the observed and synthetic firearm homicide rates over time.
observed_synthetic_plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = year, y = rate, color = type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = treatment_year, color = "#43B5E8", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Observed" = "#4E6A79", "Synthetic" = "#F28E2B")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2024, by = 4), limits = c(1999, 2023)) +
  labs(
    title = plot_title,
    x = "Year",
    y = paste0(outcome_label, ", No. per 100,000\npopulation"),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  common_theme
```

# In-space placebo analysis

```{r placebo_analysis}
# Define a function to estimate the outcome gap for each placebo state.
get_gap_for_unit <- function(placebo_state) {
  temp_df <- df_state %>%
    mutate(treated = ifelse(state == placebo_state, 1, 0)) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  temp_fit <- augsynth(
    outcome_rate ~ treated,
    unit = state,
    time = year,
    t_int = treatment_year,
    data = temp_df,
    progfunc = "Ridge",
    scm = TRUE
  )
  
  temp_synthetic <- get_synthetic_series(
    fit_obj = temp_fit,
    data_obj = temp_df,
    treated_state_name = placebo_state
  )
  
  temp_observed <- temp_df %>%
    filter(state == placebo_state) %>%
    select(year, observed = outcome_rate)
  
  temp_observed %>%
    left_join(temp_synthetic, by = "year") %>%
    mutate(
      gap = observed - synthetic,
      placebo_unit = placebo_state,
      group = ifelse(placebo_state == treated_state, "Treatment", "Control")
    ) %>%
    select(placebo_unit, group, year, gap)
}

# Run the placebo analysis for New Jersey and every donor state.
placebo_gap_df <- bind_rows(
  lapply(unique(df_state$state), get_gap_for_unit)
)

# Plot New Jersey's outcome gap against the placebo-state gaps.
placebo_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = placebo_gap_df %>% filter(group == "Control"),
    aes(x = year, y = gap, group = placebo_unit, color = "Control states"),
    linewidth = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = placebo_gap_df %>% filter(group == "Treatment"),
    aes(x = year, y = gap, color = treated_state),
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "gray40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = treatment_year, color = "#43B5E8", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Control states" = "gray75", treated_state = "black")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2024, by = 4), limits = c(1999, 2023)) +
  labs(
    title = plot_title,
    x = "Year",
    y = paste0("Gap in ", tolower(outcome_label), ",\nper 100,000 population"),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  common_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Leave-one-out sensitivity analysis

```{r leave_one_out}
# Identify all donor states included in the analysis.
donor_states <- setdiff(unique(df_state$state), treated_state)

# Refit the model after excluding each donor state individually.
loo_results <- lapply(donor_states, function(drop_state) {
  loo_df_temp <- df_state %>%
    filter(state != drop_state) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  loo_fit <- augsynth(
    outcome_rate ~ treated,
    unit = state,
    time = year,
    t_int = treatment_year,
    data = loo_df_temp,
    progfunc = "Ridge",
    scm = TRUE
  )
  
  loo_synthetic <- get_synthetic_series(
    fit_obj = loo_fit,
    data_obj = loo_df_temp,
    treated_state_name = treated_state
  )
  
  loo_observed <- loo_df_temp %>%
    filter(state == treated_state) %>%
    select(year, observed = outcome_rate)
  
  loo_gap <- loo_observed %>%
    left_join(loo_synthetic, by = "year") %>%
    mutate(gap = observed - synthetic)
  
  loo_att <- loo_gap %>%
    filter(year >= treatment_year) %>%
    summarise(avg_att = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(avg_att)
  
  data.frame(
    excluded_state = drop_state,
    avg_att = loo_att,
    deviation_from_main = loo_att - main_att,
    percent_deviation_from_main = ((loo_att - main_att) / abs(main_att)) * 100
  )
})



# Summarize the observed, synthetic, and treatment-effect estimates after 2019.
post_summary <- gap_df %>%
  filter(year >= treatment_year) %>%
  summarise(
    observed_post_mean = mean(observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    synthetic_post_mean = mean(synthetic, na.rm = TRUE),
    average_att = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    relative_reduction_percent =
      ((synthetic_post_mean - observed_post_mean) /
         synthetic_post_mean) * 100
  )

# Extract the main postintervention estimates from the summary.
observed_post_mean <- post_summary$observed_post_mean
synthetic_post_mean <- post_summary$synthetic_post_mean
main_att <- post_summary$average_att
relative_reduction_percent <- post_summary$relative_reduction_percent

# Combine and rank the leave-one-out results by their absolute deviation.
loo_df <- bind_rows(loo_results) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(percent_deviation_from_main)))

# Format the observed series for the leave-one-out plot.
observed_series <- observed_df %>%
  rename(rate = observed) %>%
  mutate(type = "Observed")

# Format the main synthetic series for the leave-one-out plot.
main_synthetic_series <- synthetic_df %>%
  rename(rate = synthetic) %>%
  mutate(type = "Synthetic")

# Refit the model after excluding each of the three highest-weight donor states.
loo_plot_list <- lapply(top_loo_states, function(drop_state) {
  loo_data <- df_state %>%
    filter(state != drop_state) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  loo_fit <- augsynth(
    outcome_rate ~ treated,
    unit = state,
    time = year,
    t_int = treatment_year,
    data = loo_data,
    progfunc = "Ridge",
    scm = TRUE
  )
  
  get_synthetic_series(
    fit_obj = loo_fit,
    data_obj = loo_data,
    treated_state_name = treated_state
  ) %>%
    rename(rate = synthetic) %>%
    mutate(type = paste0("Excluding ", drop_state))
})

# Combine the observed, synthetic, and leave-one-out series for plotting.
loo_plot_df <- bind_rows(
  observed_series,
  main_synthetic_series,
  bind_rows(loo_plot_list)
)

# Set the order of the lines shown in the leave-one-out plot legend.
loo_plot_df$type <- factor(
  loo_plot_df$type,
  levels = c("Observed", "Synthetic", paste0("Excluding ", top_loo_states))
)

# Define colors for the observed, synthetic, and leave-one-out series.
loo_color_values <- c(
  "#4E6A79",
  "#F28E2B",
  "#C58AA8",
  "#7F9CA3",
  "#D49A6A"
)

# Assign the corresponding series names to the plot colors.
names(loo_color_values) <- c(
  "Observed",
  "Synthetic",
  paste0("Excluding ", top_loo_states)
)

# Plot the main analysis and the three highest-weight leave-one-out estimates.
loo_plot <- ggplot(loo_plot_df, aes(x = year, y = rate, color = type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = treatment_year, color = "#43B5E8", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = loo_color_values) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2024, by = 4), limits = c(1999, 2023)) +
  labs(
    title = plot_title,
    x = "Year",
    y = paste0(outcome_label, ", No. per 100,000\npopulation"),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  common_theme +
  theme(legend.key.width = unit(1.4, "cm"))



# Summarize the stability of the treatment effect across leave-one-out models.
loo_stability_summary <- loo_df %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abs_percent_deviation =
      mean(abs(percent_deviation_from_main), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    max_abs_percent_deviation =
      max(abs(percent_deviation_from_main), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    min_loo_att =
      min(avg_att, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    max_loo_att =
      max(avg_att, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    direction_changed =
      any(sign(avg_att) != sign(main_att))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    threshold_percent = 10,
    stable = mean_abs_percent_deviation < threshold_percent
  )

# Print the leave-one-out stability summary.
print(loo_stability_summary)

# Save the leave-one-out stability summary.
write_csv(
  loo_stability_summary,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(output_prefix, "_loo_stability_summary.csv")
  )
)
```

# Create a summary of the main analysis settings and results.
result_summary <- data.frame(
  outcome = outcome_label,
  plot_title = plot_title,
  treated_state = treated_state,
  subgroup = plot_subgroup,
  treatment_year = treatment_year,
  observed_post_mean = observed_post_mean,
  synthetic_post_mean = synthetic_post_mean,
  average_att_manual = main_att,
  relative_reduction_percent = relative_reduction_percent,
  n_states = length(unique(df_state$state)),
  n_donors = length(setdiff(unique(df_state$state), treated_state)),
  top_loo_state_1 = top_loo_states[1],
  top_loo_state_2 = top_loo_states[2],
  top_loo_state_3 = top_loo_states[3],
  fit_object_file = paste0(output_prefix, "_fit_ascm.rds")
)

# Save the main result summary.
write_csv(
  result_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_result_summary.csv"))
)
